title: Balloons Above the Valley
specs: Pioneering hot air balloon rides in Napa Valley since 1975
Flights offer views over Napa Valley and adjacent valleys
No age restrictions but minimum height 48 inches; children must stand on their own for about one hour
Not recommended for expectant mothers; pilot may refuse pregnant passengers for safety
All passengers must be able to stand independently in the basket for at least one hour
No weight limit but guests should notify if concerned
Different size balloons accommodate 2, 4, or 20 passengers depending on group size
includes: Pre-flight coffee & pastries at The Estate Yountville
Post Flight Transportation to The Estate Yountville
gap: Exact price for private or group flights not stated
blurb: Guests meet about 30 minutes before sunrise at 6525 Washington Street, Yountville for coffee and pastries and a preflight orientation. The balloon flight lasts 45 minutes to 1 hour, followed by transportation back to the meeting point. Flights operate year-round, weather permitting, with several launch sites in Napa Valley and adjacent valleys.
extraNote: Cancel at least 48 hours before flight to avoid full charge · No charge and option to reschedule if flight cancelled due to weather · Gift certificates are non-refundable but transferable; must cancel 48 hours prior to avoid voiding · 6525 Washington St, Yountville, CA 94599 · Year-round, weather permitting
